Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: A confirmed Saint Martin trip booking containing travel pass and vessel reservations

passNumber.description: Unique QR travel pass ID (e.g. STM-2025-9942)

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who made the reservation

passengerName.description: Full name of the primary passenger matching NID

phone.description: Contact mobile number for SMS ticket confirmation

shipName.description: Vessel name (MV Bay One, Karnafuly Express, etc.)

resortName.description: Confirmed beachfront resort or eco cottage

travelDate.description: Departure date for the island trip

returnDate.description: Return date to Cox's Bazar / Teknaf

totalAmount.description: Total estimated package or ticket cost in BDT

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the booking was created

DriveFileRecord.title: DriveFileRecord
DriveFileRecord.description: Reference metadata for travel documents saved to user's Google Drive

fileName.description: Display name of the saved pass file

passNumber.description: Associated St. Martin travel pass number

driveUrl.description: Web link to view file in Google Drive

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this Google Drive record

savedAt.description: Timestamp when the file was saved to Google Drive

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Collection of verified island trip bookings and travel passes

/users/{userId}/drive_docs/{docId}.description: Subcollection of Google Drive pass receipts for a user
